Enemy models within the Pulse that have a Poison Marker gain a Poisoned (X) Marker and a Spirit Block Marker.
X may not be greater than 3.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When an Enemy model uses a Ki Feat within the Aura, that model gains a Poisoned (2) Marker.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This model's Controller chooses up to three other Friendly Acolytes within the Pulse's area of effect.
Those models immediately perform a Walk up to their Move stat in inches.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Target Friendly Acolyte and all Friendly models that share that profile card gain Group until the end of the current activation.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Perform an Opposed Move Test against Target Enemy model.
If this model is successful, place it in BtB with the Enemy model and this model applies a Held Marker to the Enemy model.
The range of this Ki Feat is equal to this model's Move statistic.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the start of a Melee Exchange, if a Friendly model is providing a Melee Assist penalty to the Enemy model, the Enemy model gains a Poisoned (X) Marker.
X cannot be greater than 2.
This Ki Feat may only be used once per Melee Exchange.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Remove all Berserk, Bleed, Blind, Fire, Impetuous, Poison or Stunned markers from Friendly models within 3" and place them on the Target model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Target Enemy model gains X Poisoned (1) Markers.
X cannot be greater than 3.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Target Friendly Acolyte gains Move Boost 2 until the End Phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This model may use its Move statistic instead of any other statistic for the current test or Melee Exchange.
Apply any modifiers, re-rolls, or substitutions as if this model was using the appropriate statistic.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When this model declares a Ranged Attack Action its Ranged Weapon gains one of the following until the current Ranged Attack Action is resolved:
- +2 Weapon Strength
- Lightweight
- Ranged Weapon Bands become 4/8/12

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This Ki feat may only be used in the Main Phase.
Replace this model with Mizuko, they are considered the same model for non-wound box transfer effects.
Place Shōgo-Ryu Elsewhere, transfer wound box effects to Shōgo-Ryu's profile card.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Until the End Phase, when Target model is successfully attacked in a Melee Exchange, after the activation is complete, the opposing model gains an On Fire (2) Marker.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This Ki Feat may be used while Elsewhere. Use only in the Starting Phase.
Choose one of the following:
- If this model is Elsewhere it gains Flank and returns to play this turn using those rules.
- Replace Mizuko with Mizuko & Shōgo-Ryu. They are considered the same model for non-Wound box transfer effects. Transfer wound box effects from Shōgo-Ryu to Mizuko & Shōgo-Ryu, remove Shōgo-Ryu from play. Leave marked Wound boxes on Mizuko's profile.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Target Friendly Dragon model not affected by the Order Action this turn gains an Activation Counter.
A model may only be affected by this Ki Feat once per turn from any source.
That model now counts as having been affected by the Order Action for the purpose of further Order Actions this turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Target Friendly Shisai model gains a Virtue Token.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When this model charges, it gains Intangible for the Charge Move.
For each Objective moved through during this Charge, you may change that Objective's alignment one degree (Enemy - Neutral - Friendly).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
After this model completes any Ranged Attack, this model makes another Ranged Attack, ignoring Reload Markers, at the same model.
Instead of making a Ranged Attack Test, the Result is the same as the previous shot, compare the result to the Target Number and roll Damage as usual.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When this model Charges, it may move through models and ignore ZoC.  
Each model that you own moved through may be placed in BtB with the Charge Target if possible.  
Models Placed in this way may remove any Controlled, Diseased, On Fire, Poisoned, Prone, or Spirit Block Markers.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Target Other Friendly Samurai model gains Co-ordinated Attack [Samurai] until the current action is resolved.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Place this model Elsewhere.  
It gains Flank and returns to play using those rules.  
The table edge chosen to return on must be Friendly.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When this model charges it gains Intangible, loses Unstable and its Nagamaki Melee Weapon gains Unblockable (1) until the end of the current activation.  
In the Start Phase of the next turn this model gains an Impetuous Marker.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Other Friendly non-Kami, non-Soulless models in the Aura when this Ki Feat is used gain 1 Ki Token.
Friendly Imperial models in the Aura gain Bodyguard [Imperial ](3").

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When a Target enemy model uses a Ki Feat, that model gains a Spirit Block Marker and may not use that Ki Feat again until the end of the following turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Enemy models in BtB with this model gain Slow and cannot benefit from Dodge or Parry Traits until the end of this activation.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Remove all Berserk, Bleed, Blind, Control, Disease, Fire, Frightened, Impetuous, Immobilised, Poison, Spirit Block, and Stunned Markers from all models (Friendly and Enemy) within the Pulse's area of effect.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains Immovable while in BtB with an Impassable Terrain Element until the End Phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
In a Melee Exchange, the Enemy model (and its Melee Weapons) lose Kata, Feint, Brutal, Parry, Dodge, Unblockable and Impenetrable Defence.  
This model gains any Traits the Enemy model loses with the same values.  
This Ki Feat ends at the end of the current Activation.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Target Enemy model loses Cloudwalk and gains Slow until the End Phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Target other Friendly Outcast model gains Rise (3) until the end of the current activation.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and Target Enemy model gain a Blind Marker.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Target Enemy model suffers one Wound and loses one Ki Token. This model gains a Ki Token.  
If Targeting a Kami model, this Ki Feat is no longer an Opposed Ki Feat.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When another Friendly Faction model in the Pulse fails a Fear Test; instead it passes that Test and suffers one Wound.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Select and activate up to 3 other Friendly Hagewashi models within 6".  
Those models gain one Activation Counter each and each model performs a Standard, Simple action. The order the models activate in is chosen by this model's Controller, after each action is resolved remove an activation counter from the activating model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
For the next Damage roll, this model's Recurve Bow weapon gains +X Weapon Strength where X is the number of marked Wound Boxes on the Target's card.  
After the Damage roll, you may have the Target lose Y Ki Tokens or gain Y Bleed (1) Markers where Y is equal to the final Damage (ignoring Durable if a Kami model) that would have been inflicted. If you do, this Ranged Attack causes no Damage.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Target a model at the start of any model's activation, before that model's Action is declared, this model performs a Ranged Challenge (7) test.  
If successful, the Target Enemy model gains Slow until the end of the current activation and a Stunned Marker.  
This is a Trap effect.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While using its Claws Melee Weapon, if this model causes Damage, the Enemy model gains a Blind Marker after the Damage Roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Enemy models may not resolve Scenario Actions within this model's ZoC even if this model's ZoC can be ignored due to being Insignificant or in BtB with an Enemy model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Transfer one Bleed, Blind, Diseased, Death Sentence, Immobilised, Impetuous, Fire, Poison, Spirit Block, or Stunned State Marker from one non-Soulless model to another non-Soulless model, both models must be within the Pulse.
If this affects an Enemy model, first make one Opp.Ki test against the Enemy model transferring the State Marker, or if transferring from a Friendly model to an Enemy model, test against the Enemy model receiving the State Marker.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Use any time, except while a model is activating.
One Enemy model in BtB gains an Activation Counter. If it does, this model may gain an Activation Counter.
This model's controller gains a Pass Token.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this model deals Damage during this Melee exchange, the Enemy non-Void Element model removes an Activation Counter.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This Eclipse gains Soulless, and its Ki Stat becomes 0/8.
Then Summon and Deploy a Reikon from Jigoku in BtB with this Eclipse model. That Reikon from Jigoku comes into play with two Activation Counters.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This Reikon from Jigoku gains Fear (6) and Dread (1) for the current activation.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Use this Ki Feat any time except during a Melee Exchange.
Swap positions between this model and one Friendly Unknown & Ninja model currently on the Battlefield (this is a Replace effect).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Use this Ki Feat while the Active Player, except when a model is activating.
Remove this Reikon from Jigoku from play.
The Eclipse model you own gains one Ki Token and does not suffer Wounds for this model's Unique Effect.
This Ki Feat may reduce this model's Ki Tokens to zero.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this model uses its Pack trait, any other Friendly models that activate gain +1 Melee Pool until the end of the current activation.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Move Target non-Kami, non-Asura, Insignificant model up to 4", this model may not end in BtB with any other models.  
A model may only be Targeted by this feat once per turn.  
If used on an Enemy model you must succeed an Opposed Ki test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
You may use this Ki Feat when a Friendly unarmoured Courtier Model within 4" is selected or targeted by an Enemy model's declared Melee, Charge or Range Attack Action.  
This model swaps positions with the Target Courtier model.  
Continue with the Declared Action with this model, including any Damage rolls.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Target other Courtier model that does not have the Armour trait gains an Activation Counter.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Use after a Simple Scenario Action, Target Enemy model's Scenario Points for that Action instead count towards your score or you may choose the new alignment in either direction by one degree instead of your opponent.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When Target Enemy model declares an action it must make an opposed Ki Challenge test with this model, if it fails its activation ends and it loses an Activation Counter.  
This is a Trap effect.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Choose a Trait on Target non-Animal, non-Insignificant, non-Soulless model's Profile Card.  
This model gains that Trait until the End Phase.  
If the Target model is an Enemy, you must first succeed in an Opposed Ki Test with the Target model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Replace this model's Long Masakari Sweep Attack for a non-exceptional Special Attack or Defence on Target other model's Profile Card at cost (1).  
If the Target model is an Enemy, you must first succeed in an Opposed Ki Test with the Target model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Remove one Berserk, Blind, Death Sentence, Impetuous, Spirit Block, Stunned or Frightened Marker from this model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: For the current Activation, this model gains Indomitable (+X) where X is the number of Enemy models in BtB with this model and, on a successful Sweep Attack, all Enemy models in BtB with this model gain a Prone Marker.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When this model Moves into BtB with an Enemy model, all Enemy models not in BtB with this model within 1" of this model must Move into BtB with this model by the shortest possible route.  
If it is not possible to put at least one Enemy model in BtB with this model, this feat may not be used.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per Activation, when this model moves into BtB with an Enemy model, that model gains an Impetuous Marker.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: During an Enemy model's activation in which it enters BtB with this model, that model gains a Stunned Marker.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Move this model up to 4", it must end its move in BtB with one Enemy model.  
The Enemy model in BtB must make a Size Challenge Test (6) or gain a Prone Marker.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Target Enemy model gains Insignificant until the end of the current activation.  
This is a Trap effect.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Choose one Type on Target Enemy model and replace it with the Unknown type until the End Phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains Lighting Reflexes when using its Tessen Melee Weapon until the end of the current activation.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When Target model is Killed you may ignore any Enemy Effects, Events or Ki Feats triggered by being Killed.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When Target Enemy model declares an Opposed Ki Test, this model performs an Opposed Ki Test with that Enemy model.  
If this model wins the Opposed Ki Test, the Enemy model's Ki Feat is not resolved and that model's Activation ends, it removes an Activation Counter.  
This is a Trap effect.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Soulless models may not Deploy or be Placed within this Aura and gain [[Weak]] while within this Aura.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Transfer Auras and State Markers that are not Disguise, Held, Prone, or Reload Markers from this model to Target.  
Centre any Auras on that model, the Aura now originates from that model.  
If used on an Enemy model you must succeed in an Opposed Ki Test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Transfer Auras and State Markers that are not Disguised, Held, Prone, or Reload Markers from Target model to this model.  
Centre any Auras on this model, the Aura now originates from this model.  
If used on an Enemy model you must succeed in an Opposed Ki Test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Auras centred on this model do not end in the End Phase.
